And then rotated the emitter. I don't know if it was another direction or more the same way, but it made a little black ball in the air where no light was escape escaping looking like a little black hole
tellings.difference: Adds that the emitter was rotated to make the ball.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Lazar's firsthand account of the S-4 emitter making a little black ball where no light escaped.

as_told.title: Lazar's reactor emitter creates a little black ball

plain: Bob Lazar says he watched a colleague, Barry Castilio, work a device called an emitter at S4, the secret Nevada site where Lazar says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s. According to Lazar, it made "a little black ball in the air where no light was escaping, looking like a little black hole." He tells this first-hand on two episodes, and in the second he adds that the ball appeared when the emitter was rotated.
